Disabling idempotency middleware is prohibited because it caused duplicate invoices. Never pin or upgrade a GitHub Action in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` yourself; send the change to @devin in #ci-pins instead. Staging Redis moved to `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is being drained and must not receive writes. Use `cache-eu-3` for anything staging. Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Optimize search rebuilding while preserving index behavior. Vendor-credit CSV import is paused.

Kafka steps 3–5 done; next pending command: `kafka-reassign-partitions --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --reassignment-json-file /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json --execute`. Search embedding now uses eight workers and 100-document chunks.
